summary: Iteration 65 — AI Training Studio (Simulador Multiagente). Backend 12/12 PASS via pytest (scenarios 60, tests 20, matrix 31, single-run with real LLM, runs history, auth). Frontend Playwright PASS — all 4 tabs render correctly inside Training Studio modal: Cenários (60), Testes (20 + Executar todos), Matriz (31 with category chips), Histórico (KPIs Execuções=2, Aprovados=1, Reprovados=1, Nota Média=8.15/10). ui_bugs.issue: Modal does NOT close on ESC key press — only via the X button. Minor UX gap.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Comes from emergent dev-only wrapper around <option> children inside the category <select>. Dev-only — no user-facing impact but adds console noise.

critical_code_review_comments: ai_training.py: Run-test endpoint correctly executes Isabela (chat_completion) → captures response → Avaliador with json_mode=True. Handles stripped ```json wrappers. Persists runs in ai_training_runs with full payload — good for history/audit.
ai_training.py: run-all uses Semaphore(5) — reasonable concurrency for OpenRouter rate limits.
ai_training.py: All endpoints exclude _id projection — no MongoDB ObjectId leak.
ai_training.py: Uses require_role('gestor') — proper RBAC. Returns 401/403 without token (verified).

TrainingStudio.js: Select <option> children contain dynamic <span> wrappers causing React hydration warning. Should ensure option content is plain text only (e.g., `<option value=...>{label}</option>` without nested expressions that compile to spans).
TrainingStudio.js: Modal lacks ESC-to-close handler (window.addEventListener('keydown')). Consider adding for accessibility.

No file exceeds 700 lines noticeably (TrainingStudio is ~1090 lines for the WHOLE modal+4 tabs — borderline, could be split into tabs/ folder for maintainability, but acceptable since each tab is a self-contained sub-component).
action_items: (Optional/Low) Add ESC-to-close handler in TrainingStudio modal for better UX/accessibility.

(Optional/Low) Refactor category <select> options in ScenariosTab to avoid React hydration warning ('<span> cannot be a child of <option>'). The warning is benign in production builds but pollutes dev console.
(Optional) Consider splitting TrainingStudio.js (~1090 lines) into /TrainingStudio/{ScenariosTab,TestsTab,MatrixTab,HistoryTab}.js for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: None — all 60 scenarios, 20 tests, 31 matrix rules were already seeded by main agent. One real test run (#1) was executed during testing and persisted in ai_training_runs (visible in Histórico tab with score 9.5/10).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Training Studio is fully functional end-to-end. Backend regression suite in /app/backend/tests/test_iter65_ai_training.py (12 cases, ~20s). Real LLM call for run-test takes ~18-30s. Run-all NOT tested (would take ~5min × 20 tests at avg 15s each). If LLM cost/latency is a concern, consider skipping or rate-limiting run-all in production. POST /tests/run-all endpoint exists and is wired in UI ('Executar todos' button visible). No critical bugs; only 2 low-priority polish items (ESC handler + option<span> hydration warning).
